skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 90% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK DMG to each enemy in a column, with a 100% chance to inflict [Weaken] on the main target (reduces ATK% for 1 turn).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK DMG to each enemy in a column, with a 100% chance to inflict [Weaken] on the main target (reduces ATK by 30% for 1 turn).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. After being attacked, has a 25% chance to increase own DMG by 10% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. After being attacked, has a 25% chance to increase own DMG% for 1 turn.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP%. After being attacked, has a 25% chance to increase own DMG by 25% for 1 turn.

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
